digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command - lock health checks
propositions: rebar doctor lacks diagnostic surface for inspecting held or orphaned locks; operators cannot determine lock holder identity, process liveness, or hold duration without manual filesystem inspection

lock health checks must reuse existing probing primitives (write_lock_is_busy, v2 stamp parsing, liveness determination, age calculation, staleness authority) and expose held/free state, holder identity, holder liveness, hold age, and staleness status per lock leg

a stale lock (determined solely by lock_owner._mkdir_lock_is_stale with no independent heuristic) must generate a finding and exit code 1; a held lock with a live holder must not generate a finding and must exit 0
doctor lock checks must be read-only and never mutate lock state, create lock files, or be affected by --repair flag
lock health report must include four legs (tickets-write-fcntl, tickets-write-mkdir, hlc, enrich-drain) with held/free/absent state and JSON schema/CLI documentation updated
